scope: Static source and assigned TASK.md review only; renderer code was not executed or edited

material_requirement_failure.finding: Computed luminance is stored in upper cell bits but never influences emitted dots or terminal colour. The emitted Braille mask is independent of lighting.

other_rendering_limits.cube: Rotated unit-cube extent can exceed the viewport at its selected scale, causing clipping. It uses fixed-light Lambert shading rather than a direct viewer-facing scalar.
other_rendering_limits.pyramid: Depth buffer initialized to zero discards all z<=0 samples; depth is averaged from edge projections instead of interpolated on the face plane.
other_rendering_limits.torus: Depth buffer is per character cell rather than per Braille dot, and old dot bits remain when a closer sample arrives.
other_rendering_limits.sphere: Sphere uses a correct analytic front hemisphere with Lambert/dither shading and rotating longitude pattern; no material geometry defect identified statically.

braille_mapping: All four use the standard 2x4 Braille bit mapping.
rotation_resize_cleanup: All read terminal size in their frame loops and implement requested Ctrl-C cursor restoration. Rotation and frame pacing are present; actual FPS/appearance were not measured here.
runtime_visual_evidence: Parent validates live panes, processes and pixels separately. Source findings prevent a claim that all four satisfy every requested visual requirement.
